Title: Diagnosis
Details: The failing test case `isUnixSymlinkIsFalseIfMoreThanOneFlagIsSet()` is designed to ensure that the method `isUnixSymlink()` should return `false` if more than just the Unix symlink flag is set in the Unix mode attributes of a `ZipArchiveEntry`. The test uses a real zip archive entry "META-INF/maven/" and expects that entry not to be treated as a symlink.

The current implementation of `ZipArchiveEntry.isUnixSymlink()` reads:
```java
public boolean isUnixSymlink() {
    return (getUnixMode() & UnixStat.LINK_FLAG) == UnixStat.LINK_FLAG;
}
```
This logic returns `true` if the bits that correspond to the symlink flag `0120000` in `UnixStat.LINK_FLAG` are set in the Unix mode, regardless of whether additional bits are also set.

The `getUnixMode()` method returns the upper bits of the external attributes shifted correctly if the platform is Unix. The Unix mode value thus can contain multiple flags combined bitwise.

The issue arises because when the Unix mode contains multiple flags (e.g., `177777` in octal, which has more than one flag set), the condition `(getUnixMode() & LINK_FLAG) == LINK_FLAG` will still return `true`. This means the method wrongly identifies entries as symlinks if the symlink flag is among multiple flags, rather than exclusively set.

The user-reported bug summary and description indicate the root problem: entries with multiple flags set, including the LINK_FLAG, make `isUnixSymlink()` return `true` incorrectly.

No evidence from recent bug reports directly relates to this logic error and can be disregarded here.

Thus, the fault lies in the `ZipArchiveEntry.isUnixSymlink()` method's simplistic check for symlink status. It should not just check whether the LINK_FLAG bits are set but should also verify that no other flags bits are set, i.e., the Unix mode equals exactly `LINK_FLAG` for it to be treated as a symlink, or other specific logic to exclude cases with multiple flags set.

This diagnosis matches the behavior of the failing test `isUnixSymlinkIsFalseIfMoreThanOneFlagIsSet()` which ensures that such entries with more than one flag set are not reported as symlinks. Therefore, modifying the `isUnixSymlink()` method to reject multiple flags would resolve the incorrect `true` result when multiple flags are set.

Recommended area for fix: `ZipArchiveEntry.isUnixSymlink()` method.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
